🚀 Learning Focus

💡

Big Idea (Understanding)

Big Idea 1Mixtures can be separated or mixed by exploiting the unique physical properties of each material.

Real-world application from the sheet: If coins are accidentally dropped into sand, a student can use a magnet where the relevant component responds to magnetism, rather than picking items out one by one.

Big Idea 2We can control and change how materials interact by manipulating environmental factors.

Real-world application from the sheet: In cooking or industry, stirring and applying heat can help ingredients dissolve more quickly. The sheet highlights that factors alter results.
